tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind the lead list.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Lead cards, dialogs, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Timeline area inside the lead dialog; dialog footers.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, dividers, header bottom edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and filter-chip borders (3:1 on surface-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: names, headings, note text. On every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: company, time-ago, labels, placeholders. 4.5:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Flow Teal. Primary buttons, active filter, links, focus. As text on surface, surface-raised or brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind brand text: today's follow-up card, follow-up chip.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (primary button label). Never hard-code white.

tokens.name: depth
tokens.usage: Deep navy for large brand moments only (login panel, cover). Not for text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue follow-ups and destructive actions. As text on surface-raised or danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger text: overdue chip and overdue card.

tokens.name: status-new
tokens.usage: NEW badge text. On status-new-soft.

tokens.name: status-new-soft

tokens.name: status-contacted

tokens.name: status-contacted-soft
tokens.usage: CONTACTED badge background.

tokens.name: status-qualified
tokens.usage: QUALIFIED badge text. On status-qualified-soft.

tokens.name: status-qualified-soft
tokens.usage: QUALIFIED badge background.

tokens.name: status-proposal

tokens.name: status-proposal-soft
tokens.usage: PROPOSAL SENT badge background.

tokens.name: status-won
tokens.usage: WON badge text. On status-won-soft.

tokens.name: status-won-soft
tokens.usage: WON badge background.

tokens.name: status-lost
tokens.usage: LOST badge text. On status-lost-soft. Lost leads are de-emphasised, not alarming.

tokens.name: status-lost-soft
tokens.usage: LOST badge background.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 2px, offset 2px. Alias of brand.
